hypothesis_source: AI following the frozen cup autopsy: 352 giveback trades, mean held MFE +9.26%, mean net -4.46%. Results for this exit have not been read.
baseline: All 2034 independent thin-book cup trades, average net 0.005438; exact membership from the preceding complete selection ledger, checked against original frozen fills
change: One structural exit: after entry, a low strictly below both adjacent market-session lows becomes confirmed only at the right-hand bar close. Maintain the highest confirmed low. A subsequent close strictly below that level signals next-market-open exit. No pre-entry swing, no profit threshold, no buffer, no window search.
execution: Original entry and earlier original exit retain precedence; T+1 and original historical costs. A missing bar, invalid price, zero-volume or conservative one-price blocked early fill retains baseline and is reported, with no rolling to a later stock session.
training: 2016-2022; all original exits and loaded bars <=2022-12-31
diagnostics: Same 2034 entries, by original loss-path label, yearly mean, signal-day equal-weight actual net, changed winners and giveback trades. Future path labels never control exit decisions.
initial_gate: At least 100 changed fills, positive mean net strictly above baseline, signal-day equal-weight actual net not below baseline, and no reduction in positive-net years. Passing only creates a research candidate requiring further execution and robustness checks; it does not replace VCP or qualify a product.
failure_action: Drop the representation and adjacent swing widths/buffers; retain original cup baseline. Do not retune three-bar confirmation.
validation: Frozen source has no 2023+ validation fills; no clean OOS claim
constraints: No 5% breakeven or entry-day close stop
No future-confirmed pivot on earlier dates
